concerns.text: Task T022 [US2] declares a dependency on T026, which is defined later in Phase 5 (User Story 3). This creates a forward‑dependency (consumer before producer) violating the required producer‑before‑consumer ordering.

User Story 2 tasks (e.g., T016, T017, T018, T019, T020, T021) depend on artifacts produced by User Story 1 (e.g., T015/data_status.json). This cross‑story dependency means US2 cannot be shipped or tested independently of US1, breaching the ‘independently‑shippable unit’ rule for user‑story groups.
